title: Page Sections

fields.label: Sections
fields.name: sections
fields.instructions: Build the page from sections. Drag to reorder.

sub_fields.label: Eyebrow
sub_fields.name: eyebrow
sub_fields.instructions: Small uppercase line above the heading.

sub_fields.label: Heading
sub_fields.name: heading
sub_fields.instructions: Each new line becomes a line break.

sub_fields.label: Desktop video
sub_fields.name: video_desktop
sub_fields.instructions: MP4, shown on screens 768px and wider.

sub_fields.label: Mobile video
sub_fields.name: video_mobile
sub_fields.instructions: MP4, shown on smaller screens. Falls back to the desktop video.

sub_fields.label: Desktop poster
sub_fields.name: poster_desktop
sub_fields.instructions: Shown while the video loads, and instead of it for visitors who prefer reduced motion.

sub_fields.label: Mobile poster
sub_fields.name: poster_mobile
sub_fields.instructions: Falls back to the desktop poster.

sub_fields.label: Section ID (anchor)
sub_fields.name: section_id
sub_fields.instructions: Used for menu links, e.g. "services" makes the link #services. Letters, numbers and dashes only.

sub_fields.label: Hide this section
sub_fields.name: hide_section
sub_fields.instructions: Keep the content but don't show it on the site.

sub_fields.label: With motion?
sub_fields.name: motion
sub_fields.instructions: Gently animate this section's content in as it appears. Visitors who've turned off motion on their device never see it.
